targetSelector.description: Workloads to which the tailscale container is added. Defaults to the primary workload.

env.description: Environment variables of the container, keyed by name.

container.description: Container of the tailscale add-on. It takes the same keys as a container of a workload.

config.description: Path of a tailscaled config file.

authkey.description: The Tailscale auth key. It is stored in a secret and loaded from there into the `TS_AUTH_KEY` environment variable of the container.

userspace.description: Run tailscale in userspace networking mode.

auth_once.description: Only log in when the node is not logged in yet.

accept_dns.description: Accept the DNS settings of the tailnet.

routes.description: Subnet routes that are advertised, comma separated.

dest_ip.description: IP that the traffic is forwarded to.

sock5_server.description: Address of a SOCKS5 proxy, eg `:1080`.

outbound_http_proxy_listen.description: Address of an outbound HTTP proxy, eg `:1055`.

settings.description: Tailscale settings. Each key sets the matching `TS_*` environment variable of the container.

description: Configuration for the tailscale addon, which adds a tailscale container that connects the pod to a tailnet.
